pages.title: Two Principles
pages.text: A thin stone slab carved with yin-yang fish, whispering of waxing and waning. It governs which $(thing)forms are enabled or disabled$(0): a form disabled by the Two Principles can no longer be taken through soul items. $(br)The Principles only sever $(thing)future$(0) bonds — those who have already transformed are untouched.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Right-click$(0) the block to view the enable state of every form in this world$(li)Players with $(thing)operator permission (level 3)$(0) may edit: click a row to toggle that form, or enable/disable all at once$(li)Changes only take effect after pressing $(thing)Apply$(0); $(thing)Cancel$(0) discards them$(br)Attempting to transform into a disabled form shows a warning, and the item is $(thing)not consumed$(0). $(br)Transforming via the $(thing)/murmol$(0) command ignores the Two Principles.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Weave black and white concrete into a taiji pattern, with a $(item)Murmol Soul$(0) at the center.
